root_cause: The outer JS wrapper called TextEncoder after invoking the source-emission command; TextEncoder is absent in this functions.exec runtime. The exception occurred before text(out) forwarded the nested command output to the model.
lesson: Preflight wrapper/runtime APIs before one-use emission, or avoid all post-emission processing and immediately forward the captured output. A one-use source tool result must not depend on an unverified wrapper feature.
next_action: Stop source-dependent work pending an owner decision. If a new request is authorized, use direct forwarding with no post-emission transformation, and confirm markers/byte count/hash before analysis.
